blurb: See Ya Later Ranch is a vineyard located high atop Hawthorne Mountain in the Okanagan Valley, producing award-winning wines. Guests can enjoy wine tastings, a ranch/fusion-style bistro, and special events such as the Friday Night Dinner Series and Pride in the Vines celebration. The ranch also offers outdoor venues for weddings and private events with scenic views.
